name: Discovery Prep
use_when: Before the client kick-off or discovery call.
inputs: Known client/domain information; scope; existing sales notes.

name: Generate Project Strategy Brief
use_when: Immediately after discovery when the call notes, scope and existing data are available.
inputs: Discovery notes; sales notes; scope; MASTER PROJECT CONTEXT if present.

name: Commercial Brief Validator
inputs: Draft Project Strategy Brief.

name: Client Clarification Request
use_when: When Stage 0 has OPEN items that materially block strategy.
inputs: Open-question list from Stage 0.
produces: Concise client email/message requesting missing facts.

name: Current Site Evidence Extraction
use_when: At the start of the audit/evidence stage.
inputs: Website/screenshots/analytics/search data; Project Strategy Brief.

name: Competitor Evidence Comparison
use_when: When competitor sites or screenshots are available.
inputs: 3–5 competitors; Project Strategy Brief; current-site evidence.
produces: Competitor evidence matrix and opportunity gaps.

name: KEEP / CHANGE / MISSING / UNCERTAIN
use_when: After current-site and competitor evidence has been collected.
inputs: Evidence notes; competitor matrix; Project Strategy Brief.

name: Evidence Pack Validator
inputs: Draft Evidence Pack.
produces: Validation report and missing evidence list.

name: Evidence → Strategic Diagnosis
use_when: Once the Evidence Pack is complete.
inputs: Project Strategy Brief; Evidence Pack.

name: Priority Stack
use_when: When the diagnosis contains too many issues.
inputs: Strategic Diagnosis; Project Strategy Brief.

name: Strategic Diagnosis Red Team
inputs: Draft diagnosis and priority stack.

name: Generate Positioning Directions
use_when: After Strategic Diagnosis is approved internally.
inputs: Project Strategy Brief; Evidence Pack; Strategic Diagnosis.

name: Select and Sharpen Positioning
inputs: Candidate directions; Project Strategy Brief; Strategic Diagnosis.

name: Brand Architecture
use_when: When the business has founders, multiple practitioners, locations or expansion plans.
inputs: Positioning Thesis; growth model; current team; service ownership.

name: Positioning Validator
inputs: Positioning Thesis; Brand Architecture; Strategic Diagnosis.

name: Client-Facing Positioning Explanation
use_when: When preparing the client deck or strategy review.
inputs: Approved Positioning Thesis; Current → Proposed evidence.

name: Existing URL Preservation Audit
inputs: Existing URL export; GSC/analytics if available; current sitemap; links/rankings if supplied.
produces: Retain / improve / merge / remove / redirect inventory.

name: Build Sitemap / IA
use_when: After positioning and URL preservation review.
inputs: Positioning Thesis; commercial priorities; user journeys; URL inventory.

name: Internal Linking + Ownership Rules
inputs: Approved sitemap; Brand Architecture.

name: Migration / Redirect Map
inputs: Existing URL inventory; approved sitemap.

name: IA + SEO Validator
inputs: Proposed sitemap; URL decisions; internal-link model; migration map.

name: Strategy → Visual Principles
use_when: Before the designer produces the style direction.
inputs: Positioning Thesis; Strategic Diagnosis; Current → Proposed; brand assets.

name: Current → Proposed Generator
use_when: When preparing the visual direction or client deck.
inputs: Current-site evidence; approved visual principles.

name: Designer Execution Prompt
use_when: When handing approved strategy to a designer or design model.
inputs: Master Project Context; Positioning Thesis; IA; visual principles.
produces: Design brief for homepage + system exploration.

name: Visual Direction Validator
inputs: Visual direction / mockups; Positioning Thesis; IA.

name: Homepage Architecture
use_when: After IA and visual direction are approved.
inputs: Positioning Thesis; sitemap; proof inventory; visual principles.

name: Page Template Generator
use_when: When defining treatment, concern, practitioner, result and other core templates.
inputs: Approved IA; Brand Architecture; proof requirements.

name: Component Library Specification
inputs: Page templates; visual system.

name: Mobile Adaptation
inputs: Desktop page architecture / mockups; conversion priorities.

name: Scalability Validator
inputs: Page templates; component library; growth model.

name: Proof Inventory Builder
use_when: Once positioning and page needs are clear.
inputs: Existing client materials; site; reviews; credentials; result assets.

name: Content Gap Plan
use_when: When page templates are known but content is incomplete.
inputs: Page templates; Proof Inventory; current copy.

name: Photography Brief Generator
use_when: Before photography is booked or final design is populated.
inputs: Visual Direction; Page System; current photography; clinic details.

name: Claims + Content Evidence Validator
inputs: Draft copy; Proof Inventory; compliance constraints.

name: Client Input Request Generator
use_when: When content/proof/photography gaps need client action.
inputs: Content Gap Plan; Proof Inventory; Photography Brief.

name: Client Strategy Deck Generator
use_when: When strategy, IA and visual direction are sufficiently mature.
inputs: Project context; positioning; Current→Proposed; mockups; proof; page system.

name: Deck Compression / Edit
use_when: When the draft deck is too long or text-heavy.
inputs: Draft deck.
produces: Tighter client deck preserving strategic content.

name: Presenter Notes
inputs: Approved client deck.

name: Client Deck Red Team
inputs: Draft deck; approved strategy.

name: Meeting Notes → Approval Record
use_when: Immediately after the client review meeting.
inputs: Meeting notes/transcript; deck; current Approval Record.

name: Feedback Classifier
use_when: When client comments arrive by email, comments or meeting notes.
inputs: Raw client feedback; locked decisions.

name: Revision Plan
inputs: Classified feedback; approved decisions; scope.

name: Approval Follow-Up
inputs: Approval Record; open decisions.

name: Change-Control Evaluator
use_when: When someone tries to reopen an approved decision.
inputs: New request; locked decision; original rationale; new evidence.

name: Input Tracker Generator
inputs: Approved page system; content gaps; proof gaps; build requirements.

name: Missing Inputs Follow-Up
use_when: When client inputs are overdue or incomplete.
inputs: Current input tracker.

name: Input Verification
use_when: When client sends a batch of information/assets.
inputs: New inputs; existing tracker; Proof Inventory.

name: Build Readiness Gate
inputs: Approved strategy; inputs; designs; sitemap; handoff artefacts.

name: Designer → Developer Handoff
inputs: Approved screens; component system; visual tokens; mobile behaviour.

name: SEO → Developer Handoff
inputs: Approved sitemap; URL map; redirects; schema/content requirements; tracking.

name: Content → Build Mapping
use_when: When approved copy/content needs mapping to templates.
inputs: Approved page copy; page templates; input tracker.

name: Build Implementation Validator
inputs: Staging site/screens; approved designs; handoffs.

name: Compliance QA
inputs: Staging content; Proof Inventory; compliance constraints; consent records.

name: Strategy / UX QA
inputs: Staging site; Positioning Thesis; IA; approved deck/screens.

name: Technical / SEO QA
inputs: Staging site; sitemap; redirect map; tracking plan.

name: Consolidated QA Triage
use_when: When the three QA streams are complete.
inputs: Compliance QA; Strategy/UX QA; Technical/SEO QA.

name: Launch Blocker Decision
use_when: When someone wants to launch with open QA items.
inputs: Consolidated QA list; deadline/business context.

name: Launch Plan
inputs: QA report; technical handoff; launch date; hosting/domain context.

name: Launch-Day Runbook
inputs: Approved Launch Plan.

name: Client Launch Notification
inputs: Launch status; known caveats; support process.

name: Measurement Baseline Capture
inputs: Analytics/GSC/GBP/booking/call data available.

name: Post-Launch Issue Triage
inputs: Issue reports; analytics; QA; client feedback.

name: 30-Day Review
inputs: Baseline; analytics; search data; issues; client feedback.

name: 60-Day Review
inputs: Baseline; 30-day review; behavioural data; search data.

name: 90-Day Commercial / Search Review
inputs: Baseline; 30/60 reviews; commercial and search data.

name: KEEP / IMPROVE / TEST / SCALE
inputs: Review findings.

name: Learning / Case Study Capture
inputs: Strategy, launch baseline, post-launch results.
produces: Internal learning record and optional case-study outline.

name: Kick-Off Email
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: Discovery Input Request
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: Strategy Review Invitation
use_when: When the client strategy deck is ready.
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: Strategy Review Follow-Up
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: Content / Photography Request
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: Revision Summary
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: Pre-Launch Approval Request
use_when: When the launch candidate is ready.
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: Launch Notification
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: 30/60/90 Review Summary
inputs: Relevant project artefacts / tracker.

name: Project Lead → Strategist
inputs: Current artefacts and Master Project Context.

name: Strategist → SEO Lead
inputs: Current artefacts and Master Project Context.

name: Strategist → Designer
inputs: Current artefacts and Master Project Context.

name: SEO Lead → Designer
inputs: Current artefacts and Master Project Context.

name: Designer → Developer
inputs: Current artefacts and Master Project Context.

name: Content Lead → Compliance Reviewer
inputs: Current artefacts and Master Project Context.

name: QA → Project Lead
inputs: Current artefacts and Master Project Context.

name: Project Lead → Client
inputs: Current artefacts and Master Project Context.
